::: {#exr-sheep-put-cotton}

Curse of dimensionality Divide an n-dimensional cube into blocks with edge length 1/3 that of the cube. For 250-dimensional space, there are roughly `1.9e119` cubes, more than the number of particles in the universe.  A 15 x 20 pixel image is a point in a 300-dimensional space. To fill that space with data is impossible.  
:::
